title: First completion of a scratch reset
statement: For every Boolean input word $x$, input-head position $p$, stream word, target word $w$, and stream-head position $s$, there is an integer time $t$ with $0<t\le 2|w|+2$ such that the reset machine, started in control state $0$ with the target head at cell $0$, is never in control state $2$ at any time $j<t$. At time $t$ it is in control state $2$, with the stream unchanged, the target erased, and the target head at cell $0$.
hypotheses_covered: control state is not 2 at every j < t
replaced: For every input word, input position, stream, target word $w$, and stream head, there is a time $t$ with $0 < t \le 2|w| + 2$ such that the reset machine first reaches its completed control exactly at $t$, with the target erased, the target head at zero, and the stream untouched.
